verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state that outgoing ACH transfers take 1–3 business days and that domestic and international wires can send same-day, with a delivery estimate shown before confirming. Its bill-pay docs describe paying vendors "the way they want to be paid," and an independent review confirms ACH sending, including same-day ACH on the Pro plan. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the vendor payment workflow and domestic wire fees, and hands-on corroboration of sending outgoing domestic wires.
